t: Earn 50 points of Hirkalla's favor by participating in the assault on the Wandering Island, then report back to Erfar the Bragger.

The ruler of Sarnaut has issued a decree: the heroes must come to the place known as the Wandering Island where they will assist the cultists of Sarn who are waging an endless battle against the wayward Wormfaces and Draconids.

Hirkalla the Darkest sees what mortals cannot see: in the final battles of the Great War that is coming, the cultists will play their role. Most of all, she wishes to protect the shard of great power that rests next to the Palace Square, for it is the key to the coming triumph of mortals in battle with the insidious gods of Light and Order.

Go there, help the commanders - Dmitri Gromov and Goliath, then capture the Palace Square.
You're still here? Our ruler's patience is not infinite!
Wonderful! The assault was carried out! I will inform the mistress of your success! For now, accept your reward: the signets of our mistress which can be exchanged for useful goods.
Earn 50 points of Hirkalla's favor by participating in the Battle for Ambrosia in Eden, then report back to Erfar the Bragger.

The ruler of Sarnaut has issued a decree: the heroes must go to Eden where they can help either the Great Mage Felix or the All-Mother's Children.

Hirkalla the Darkest is wise and sees what is not visible to you: with each battle, the Children of Eden are moving further and further away from the path that the All-Mother has set for them. Faced with death, they rebel, refusing to accept it. Thus, they are getting closer to accepting the truth of Nihaz. Just like the inhabitants of Sarnaut who hone their skills and gain Ambrosia which serves the development of your world. So let the flames of war burn, as our goddess commands.

Go there and fight: either for the Expedition or for the Children.
The mistress's orders have not been carried out yet? How dare you anger her?

Wonderful! The battle is over! It does not matter who won. I will inform the mistress of your success! For now, accept your reward: the signets of our mistress which can be exchanged for useful goods.
Earn 50 points of Hirkalla's favor by opening treasures during the Storm on Suslanger, then report back to Erfar the Bragger.

The ruler of Sarnaut has issued a decree: the heroes should travel to Suslanger where, during a sandstorm, they must find as many of Nezeb's treasures as possible.

Hirkalla the Darkest is generous, and it gives her pleasure to see her subjects acquire more and more new treasures. The stronger you become, the more power you will represent when the false gods of Light and Order appear in this world. And though the weak will fall along the way, the rest will become much stronger.

Go there and look for treasures.
I left Suslanger a long time ago, and that old Jinn is still there.

Wonderful! The storm is over, and the treasures have found their owners! But many more treasures still lie under the sands, and malicious Ifrits continue to guard them. We will deal with them later, but for now, take what you have earned - our mistress's signets which can be exchanged for the goods you need.
Earn 50 points of Hirkalla's favor by participating in the Hunt for Uro-Boros on Suslanger, then report back to Erfar the Bragger.

The ruler of Sarnaut has issued a decree: the heroes must travel to Suslanger and participate in the hunt for the great worm - Uro-Boros!

Hirkalla the Darkest is prudent: she foresees that in the future the heroes still have to fight monsters on the paths between the worlds. Therefore, the battle with this worm Uro-Boros will be a good training for future challenges. Now Reya the Merciless is waiting for you, ready to announce another hunt. Only those who have passed the trial of the desert will be able to join the army of the Darkest Goddess.

Go there and join the Orcs of the Landfill to slay this worm!
The worm is still alive! Do not disappoint our ruler!

Wonderful! The worm is dead and the Orcs of the Landfill are celebrating yet another victory. Of course, Uro-Boros will rise again, but for now, take what you have earned - the signets of our lady, which can be exchanged for the goods you need.
Ask Erfar the Bragger about Hirkalla's decrees.

Hello there, hero! Chosen One!

We already know each other, so I see no point in introducing myself. I will say the following: as soon as Mistress appeared in our world, I immediately found her and offered my services. And now we expect service from you.

If you are dutiful, you will be rewarded. How? I will tell you about it if you are interested...
The Darkest Mistress does not tolerate tardiness! Neither do I, her loyal servant.

Didn't expect that, did you, ? It's amazing how things turn out! Rags for some, riches for others. And that's just the beginning - mark my word. Mistress Hirkalla will shake up our whole world and rebuild it in her own way. Life will change for the better!

Especially for those who died a long time ago, hehe... Times are changing, . They are changing.

From now on you will receive our ruler's decrees from me every day. And acquire appropriate rewards - but the amount is limited, so choose wisely. Mistress loves order.
Complete 3 of Hirkalla's Decrees and report back to Erfar the Bragger.

I am Erfar the Bragger, once the headman of the Village on Gipat, and now the viceroy of Hirkalla the Darkest in the League and the Empire. I am ready to offer new tasks to heroes.

You must fulfill at least three of Hirkalla's decrees this week in order to earn Mistress's favor. Those who fulfill them will be generously rewarded! Workpieces for the best equipment and a special currency - symbols of the Darkest One's favor - await the heroes.
Mistress values loyalty. Keep it up, and she will generously reward you!

This is only a small part of the our Darkest Mistress's grace!

Now, in the depths of the astral plane, on the forgotten allod Jigran, a new capital is being built - Dar Ulgorn. Soon its most faithful servants will be able to travel there. Those who were dead will be given new lives!
Tell about the death of gods to the Keeper of Secrets in Nezebgrad.

Wait, are you telling me that Sarn and the Architect have killed each other in a massive battle? And nothing is threatening Sarnaut anymore? And you want me to believe it without any evidence? Well, like I have a choice...

Luckily, very few people know that gods exist. For most of them, Architects are just insentient creatures from nowhere, and hardly any of them know who Sarn was. If you are telling the truth, and gods exist no more, then it won't really affect the lives of regular folks.

We'll see whether you're telling the truth or not as soon as the Astral storm eases off and we send an expedition to the site of battle. If it all had really happened the way you tell it, then you will be indeed the greatest hero in Sarnaut!

It's not the first time that you save the world, you know. But this time no one should know about it. This is too big. Some will start worshipping you, some will start hating you. This will do none of us any good...

But at least you should speak with Mark Staritsyn - the future generations deserve to know who they owe their lives to.
Well, do you have a story for the next chronicle chapter?
Tell about the death of gods to the Keeper of Secrets in Novograd.

Luckily, very few people know that gods exist. For most of them, Architects are just insentient creatures from nowhere, and hardly any of them know who Sarn was. If you are telling the truth, and gods exist no more, then it won't really affect the lives of regular folks.

But at least you should speak with Lovewise Catfish - the future generations deserve to know who they owe their lives to.
Well, do you have a story for the next chronicle chapter?
Enter the Destroyer Temple and defeat their Champion.

Behind these gates is the temple of the most powerful Wormface warriors who call themselves the Destroyers. They are mighty enemies, and the power of the Seal Shard makes them deadly. You shouldn't face them on your own. Join a raid, and maybe you will make it out of the sanctuary alive!
Only the strongest of the strongest are allowed to touch the Shrine!

So you come from the surface... We've been watching you.

You wish to touch our Shrine? Learn the secrets of the Origins? Well, since you've come here, I can assume you know how to do that. The only question is, are you worthy?
Defeat Bastion and take the Seal Shard.

I can't believe it... You defeated Teumim. You are strong... I won't stand in the way of the strongest, but I am warning you: what you are looking for, will only bring you trouble. The Bowl of Origins grants power, but in the hands of the unworthy, it can hurl the world into chaos.

In order to be able to touch the Bowl, we spend years in meditation, learning self-control and purifying our minds. The Guard protects the Bowl from those who think they can handle its power without preparing themselves. Do you want to take it? Go ahead! We will bury your crippled bodies in this temple!

Looks like a great battle is upon you. I'm sorry, I will not be a part of it - I don't have the right to risk my life fighting rusty June scrap metal. And also, who else will be there to sing songs about your heroic deeds and pay our last respects to you?

This thing is huge... I didn't know Junes were that advanced in magic technology. Looks like they built that monstrous thing not long before they were extinct. Alas, it didn't save them from the divine curse.

But we did a good job! Now we have the keys to the Seals, and I can weaken them just enough to let Sarn into our world but not let him destroy it.
Defeat Sirius, the Guard of the Star Gates, and talk to Klavdia Kalugina.

My father created the Star Gates for his own purposes only. Even I can't bypass the powerful spells that are to designed to kill anyone who tries to travel between the worlds.

I'm sure that with your assistance I will be able to weaken their defense, but be ready to fight. I have no idea what we might face, but I know my father loves surprises. So be prepared to anything!

Phew! The Void Dragon... I didn't think anyone could make a creature like this one serve them. I heard that these Dragons live in the Void between the worlds. The Great Dragons who guard Sarn's prison were created in their image. I hope there will be no more surprises like this one.
Survive the battle of the Gods and make sure Sarn and the Architect kill each other.

The Gates are about to let one mighty enemy into our world, and the Seals can barely contain the rage of the other one... I'm ashamed to say that, but I'm scared. Very scared! The greatest battle in history is about to unfold in front of our eyes, and I'm trembling like a village girl at the sight of a soldier.

I'm sure my plan will work, but we can't afford to make a single mistake. The gods have to destroy each other. If one of them wins, it will be the end of everything that you know and love. It will be the end of me. So there will be no winners in this battle!
Well, well... Is it something urgent, or are you just abusing your privilege to meet me without making an appointment?

What happened? The Astral has gone crazy! All magical flows are tied in a knot! We had to stop all mana reactors at XAES in order to avoid reactor reload. I think even village healers felt the enormous surge of energy that ran through the world. I have a feeling that this is why you are here. I hope we're not facing another Cataclysm?!

The Gates are open; the Seal is broken, but there is a small problem. There it is, right over your head. If I am right, and I am always right, it is called the Void Dragon. It does not belong to our world, and I'm afraid I don't know its weaknesses. All that I can do is alter the gravity so that you can battle the beast from close range, but no more than that. I am hanging on by the skin of my teeth here.
Wow... I didn't expect that from my father!
You quitters! This could be fun... Do you have any other heroes there? These ones won't fight!
I can't believe it... We did it!

Looks like a great battle is upon you. I'm sorry, I will not be a part of it - I don't have the right to risk my life fighting rusty June scrap metal. And also, who else will be there to sing songs about your heroic deeds and pay our last respects to you?
Survive the battle of the Gods and make sure Sarn and the Architect kill each other.

The Gates are about to let one mighty enemy into our world, and the Seals can barely contain the rage of the other one... I'm ashamed to say that, but I'm scared. Very scared! The greatest battle in history is about to unfold in front of our eyes, and I'm trembling like a village girl at the sight of a soldier.

I'm sure my plan will work, but we can't afford to make a single mistake. The gods have to destroy each other. If one of them wins, it will be the end of everything that you know and love. It will be the end of me. So there will be no winners in this battle!

I can feel that something terrible has happened... Magical flows are insane; the Astral is roaring, and the whole world is cracking under the pressure of a tremendous force! I have a feeling that you have something to do with that. Well, go on, tell me!

It seems that Klavdia Kalugina came up with another plan to battle Nihaz. She invites you to Gipat to tell you about it. It makes sense to visit her as soon as possible. The fate of the world cannot wait!
Gipat is the best place for a meeting. Especially since you visited the Reversed Reality and destroyed "Daddy's" spell that allowed him to control this allod...

I'm going to show you a bit of temporal magic. I think they call it a montage at the Dream Factory.

We'll jump ahead in time a little, and I'll tell you what to do next. But if you find something else to do, I won't object. They say the Elves have arranged a Ball there. It's always like this: someone's hard at work, while others are having fun. But I think you should pay them a visit, or else you'll miss a few things.

Just remember: when you want to hear what I plan to do next - find me on Gipat Shard.
Where else would Klavdia Kalugina? On Gipat, of course.
Gipat is the best place for a meeting. Especially since you visited the Reversed Reality and destroyed "Daddy's" spell that allowed him to control this allod...
Find a way to recover your strength

We're in the right place, no...?

Even though I'm a ghost, I feel uneasy here... This feeling... as if someone is whispering in millions of different voices. It's unsettling. We can only hope that long months of wandering have not led us to a dummy.
Have you found a way to regain your strength?

I see you have recovered!

I don't even want to know how you did it. Let's finish this.

I have prepared for the removal of the barrier - I'm afraid it will take all the remaining strength...

Hopefully Danas, Naira, and Fergard with their undead armies drew the attention of the main forces away. And the demons won't notice us...
I hope it was not in vain!

Now we need to use this terminal...

I hope this is what we need. Over the months, I've seen quite a few devices like this. They control Seals. And time travel devices... that hold these Sparks...

Let's finish this...

If the Lord of the Citadel has not detected us yet, then he is probably about to... I can practically feel his gaze.
Can you believe this? We are so close to our goal!
The terminal seems to be waiting for your actions...
Find out more about what happened and about future plans

Don't be upset if you don't understand everything. I'll tell you more in time.

But we still need to discuss certain things - particularly what we're going to do...

So this... man will help us? Well, that makes our task easier...

Otherwise, we'd have had to climb these mountains for weeks, looking for the June caves. There are hundreds of them, trust me. And the Wormfaces... as you understand, after the events at the Frontier you're not the most popular person among them.

It's unsurprising. I'll explain: we were looking for the coordinates of... my mother's world. And we found them.

No, it's not about my feelings. Nihaz can't get his hands on another god's powers! Right now he's trying to invade her world. But now we have the coordinates, too...
h: I can't say everything was clear in that vision.

t:
The things I showed you happened a long time ago. We haven't been sitting idly in the meantime. We all have reasons to travel to another world.

Catherina dreams about progress. This project is just another accomplishment for her.

The elves are looking for the Beauty. They have seen everything in this world, so why not look somewhere else?

Aidenus and Yasker are looking for means to defeat Cosmos. The willful Aoidos and his ability to interfere in the course of history make them tremble with fear. But the Gates can pierce not just space, but also time. And even protect time from the Observatory's meddling.

We already had the Gates project. On Ferris. The loophole that led to Fractal is closed now, just like the rift on Dane. The Gates-2 project also failed. The island is under quarantine after the failed attempt to change the past by preventing Tep's Plague.

It's time to put together everything we know and can. And make a successful attempt this time, since we know the coordinates of the time and place where we need to be. To create Gates-3.
h: What are we going to do with them?

t:
You probably want to ask - how are we going to meet later? It's simple. My incarnation, Eladia, is on Suslanger. She is the head of the Gates-3 project. When you reach the city, find her... I mean, me! I'll tell you what we know and what we need to find out.

Now go to the ruins Erfar told you about, and I'll talk to him. Don't worry, he'll reach the place before you.
There you go! We just need to insert them like this, and then calibrate...
Ha ha! I'm kidding! Who needs that nonsense? Go stand in the center, and I'll say the right words - you'll be off in no time...
Reach the end of Klavdia's memory
I need you to watch something...
Return to the memory and reach the end.
Well, you know everything you need now... And more...
Meet Ereba in Polis on Ammer
Wait... I feel an unusual power in you, my friend. Perhaps... Go to Polis and find our cabbalist, Ereba. I believe you’ll have a lot to discuss.
You will need this ability in battle.

Ah, good to know that Celie doesn’t shirk her duties. I’m Ereba, pleased to meet you. I asked our Domina of Life to guide here people who have... special powers. You, my friend, have a fragment of the essence of Sarn himself. Whether it’s good or bad... is up to you...

The story of that demiurge is full of contradictions and, to put it mildly, dubious decisions. But you should remember that your will is your will, and it’s the only thing guiding your powers. Sarn’s legacy does not define you.
Demons are probably closer to the Aoidoi than anyone else in this world. It’s our sacred duty as scientists to study this connection and uncover its magical potential.
Find all mysterious notes on Ammer.
Find all mysterious notes and receive a reward.
This Centaur is your friend now.
Listen to Zayan, Catherina, and Klavdia.
Let’s go! The Forum is about to start. I’m curious to hear that the brightest minds of Sarnaut have to say.

It’s decided.

I foresee that Orders have a power to change this world. Perhaps it will happen soon. Perhaps you and I won’t be there to see it. Who knows? What matters is someone is watching over this world but they stay out of this senseless war between the League and Empire.
Join any of the three Orders and inform Cassandra of your choice.
I’m asking you now - what will you choose? I cannot advise you on this - all mages serve a noble cause, and each will have many followers. Will you become one of them?
Or maybe you’d rather be a lone wolf?
So be it. All Aoidoi will be keeping track of your accomplishments - and accomplishments of Orders.
Meet the master of the Order.

I’m glad it’s an easy choice for you. Going into a fight with a heavy heart makes it all that much difficult. And your mind should be clear.

Some Aoidoi offered to help the Great Mages in organizing their Orders. I believe the master of your Order can supply you with certain resources from the warehouse. I hope you’ll find the assortment to your liking.

Let me add your name to the roster... Done.

The Order can now provide you with supplies. Useful and practical.

You need to understand that the Well of Souls is a source of incredible power that belonged to two deities. The League and the Empire are craving it - I can sense that hunger. We cannot allow such a weapon to be used in their war. But... you will need the power of the Well to fight Kyros.

The Council has made a decision.
h: Ask about the Council’s decision regarding the Well of Souls.

t:
So it begins...

I can’t say this strange power does not worry me. Everything in our world is bound together by the cycle of life and death, and it’s so rude to disturb it.... It sounds like violation of natural laws. But at the same time, I’m thinking about how practical this power is, and how it can fight demons without fear. We already have one immortal Aoidos among us - Kyros. I wonder if your Gift came from the same place?

About Kyros...
h: Tell about the Power of Light.

t: Excellent. Now I need to concentrate...
h: Tell that demons drank the blood

t: Welcome to Polis. You are welcomed here.
What do you want to know?

Several of our dominae went to the west. Demons were seen in a dangerous proximity from Polis, and I can feel that something terrible might happen unless we interfere.

First, we must counterattack. Demons are aggressive and primitive, and this plays into their hands right now. If we throw them back from our border, we will win the necessary time. Then your people will arrive, and we will be saved.
h: How are we going to fight demons?

t: Receive the reward for help in founding the Order.

Wait a second, I recognize your name. I was ordered to give you certain... starter’s privileges at our warehouse. For, I quote, “your help in founding the Order and protecting Sarnaut.”

Ah well, it’s an order. I have to obey!
Tell Zayan, Catherina, and Klavdia Kalugina about Cassandra’s invitation.

Time is pressing, my friend. We need to send a message to the three chosen ones, and you’re the only one I can trust to do that. Go to Avilon, Umoir, and the Isle of Revelation - the lands of the three Mages - and ask them on behalf of the Council to come to Polis.

Here we will decide what to do with the Well’s power.
Go now! Time is of the essence.

Thank you, my friend. Our guests have arrived.

Stay with us - this is where the fate of the world is being decided. It’s thanks to you that we’re alive and well - so it’s only fair that you’ll be a witness to our agreement.
Learn about Council’s decision from Cassandra.

I’ve been waiting for you, my friend. Our brother’s betrayal was hard on all of us, but we can’t succumb to fear and despair. Dominae held a Council at dawn. We came up with a solution.

It’s a honor to hear it before all others. So listen to this.
I’m talking about the Well of Souls, a source of incredible power.

This is the Council’s decision. Whether it’s wise or rash, only time will tell. We couldn’t do nothing.

Now that you know the truth, there is something I must ask of you.
Still don’t believe it? Maybe you need to see for yourself? I know someone who can help. You’ll find her near Cosmos’ Observatory...
Why are you just standing there? Are you going to ask me anything?

I know about the events in the future where you save the Sculptor on New Isa right before the end. No matter how much I stare into the future, I see no ways of preventing that. Darkness clouds my vision. But it won’t be the end of the world... There will be survivors. And those who will find a new home. Their life will be like an ancient fairy tale - long and terrifying but with a good ending. This is a story of Horizon... Or survivors and renegades. Of people and gods. Of life and death... Of a hero’s journey...

That's right, it's been three days! We have already set up our camp and the pickets around it. You say, it's been only two hours for you? Well, this allod is one big mystery!

And the biggest one is - where did it come from? As far as I know, our leaders were expecting to find some kind of an Astral anomaly here, and not an allod that resembles an exploded volcano. There are just no other allods like this one! Believe me - I've seen many of them.

I'm not authorized to give you orders, but your help would be highly appreciated. Our scientists just can't handle all those mysteries. Talk to Negus Setuteph, maybe, you'll figure some of them out.
Greetings, colleague. I've heard a lot about your achievements, and I believe your contribution will help us advance in our research greatly.
Capture the Site of Power and return to Ilya Glibin.

Listen, I want to tell you about my observations.

I was charting the magic flows of this allod the other day, and I discovered a curious pattern: the flows cross each other in several places, creating a powerful magic resonance. Then I remembered where I'd seen it before: in the jungle of Asee-Teph. I'm sure there must be something like a Site of Power to the west from here. If you could place my focusing prism next to it, then I could redirect its energy to sustain the alarm spells. You don't think that firecracker trip wire is a sufficient security measure, do you?
So, was I right? Is there actually a Site of Power?
Ha! I knew I could rely on you - thanks to my prism and your sword, we must have really upset the League sorcerers... And now they will most probably attempt to take that Site of Power away from us.
Kill 10 League players and report to Yaver Nut.

Listen, here's the thing... We don't have an official order to start combat action, and there's actually no one to give that order - all the high command is sitting in Nezebgrad, deciding the fate of the world, while we're just rotting here.

But you're a master to yourself, aren't you? No one's going to reproach you for some ten League soldiers sent to the Purgatory. And we will find a way to thank you. Savvy?
Just don't say anything to the command. I'm so sick of all that armistice nonsense!
Kill Yelisey Obukhov in the League camp and return to Yaver Nut.

I have an idea. You'll love it.

Here is what I think: there's no point in sending League soldiers to the Purgatory. It's nothing more but a respite for them. But if we kill their leader, then they will panic, and probably even come at us. We will have to defend ourselves! We can even get rewarded for that, huh.
So, did you find the one in charge?
They're not coming for some reason. Maybe they weren't offended enough. What if we kill their Lieutenant again - will we cheese them off then? I'm itching for a good fight, you know...
Complete Gaal-Tohtar's and Ursula de Blizare's quests, then return to Bronislav Malinovsky.

That's right, it's been three days! We have already set up our camp and the pickets around it. You say, it's been only two hours for you? Well, this allod is one big mystery!

And the biggest one is - where did it come from? As far as I know, our leaders were expecting to find some kind of an Astral anomaly here, and not an allod that resembles a weird sculpture. There are just no other allods like this one! Believe me - I've seen many of them.

I'm not authorized to give you orders, but your help would be highly appreciated. Our scientists just can't handle all those mysteries. Talk to Ursula, maybe, you'll figure some of them out.
Ursula asked me to find her an assistant, and the trapper could use some help, too.
So, time runs differently here, huh? Years could have passed in Novograd by now. I guess when I come back home, my son's going to be a grandfather.
Capture the Site of Power and return to Marius de Ardeur.

Will you do me a favor?

I was charting the magic flows of this allod the other day, and I discovered a curious pattern: the flows cross each other in several places, creating a powerful magic resonance. Then I remembered where I'd seen it before: in the jungle of Asee-Teph. I'm sure there must be something like a Site of Power to the east from here. If you could place my focusing prism next to it, then I could redirect its energy to sustain the alarm spells. You don't think that firecracker trip wire is a sufficient security measure, do you?
So, was I right? Is there actually a Site of Power?

Ha! I knew I could rely on you - thanks to my prism and your sword, we must have really upset the Imperial sorcerers... And now they will most probably attempt to take that Site of Power away from us.
Kill 10 Imperial players and report to Usina Sapogov.

Listen, here's the thing... We don't have an official order to start combat action, and there's actually no one to give that order - all the high command is sitting in Novograd, deciding the fate of the world, while we're just rotting here.

But you're a master to yourself, aren't you? No one's going to reproach you for some ten Imperial soldiers sent to the Purgatory. And we will find a way to thank you. Savvy?
Just don't say anything to the command. I'm so sick of all that armistice nonsense!
Kill Knuckles the Montane on the Imperial outpost and return to Usina Sapogov.

I have an idea. You'll love it.

Here is what I think: there's no point in sending League soldiers to the Purgatory. It's nothing more but a respite for them. But if we kill their leader, then they will panic and probably come at us. We will have to defend ourselves! We might even get rewarded for that!
So, did you find the one in charge?
They're not coming for some reason. Maybe they weren't offended enough. What if we kill their Sergeant again - will we cheese them off then? I'm itching for a good fight, you know...
Find the water carriers near the spring to the east from the League camp.

Hey there!

Have you seen three gibberlings with large buckets? No? Oh, where are they!

We're trying to cook porridge to feed the whole squad, and those idlers are nowhere to be seen. We sent them to fetch some water about half an hour ago. If you see them, tell them to get here immediately, or we don't know what we're going to do to them!
Who are you? What do you want?
Oh! The Ladles must have sent you! We're... keeping the watch here! Right!
Defeat the Elementals and find out why they are angry with the gibberlings.

We almost got killed! We just came up to the spring, and all of a sudden, it all started boiling! And then it attacked us! We just had to get out of there!

Can you make the water monsters go away, please? The Ladles must be so angry with us...
Enough! Stop it if you don't want your clear waters to turn into a deadly poison!
Your friends desecrated my spring... I will not tolerate that!
Find seedlings and plant them around the spring, then talk to the Spirit.

If you wish to continue rejoicing in my gifts, then I'm expecting an apology! And not just your empty words, but your deeds!

I've been dreaming of my own garden for a long time now. Unfortunately, I know very little of the ground herbs. So I'm offering you a deal: you plant some trees for me, and I give you water. How does that sound?
I want trees! Green, green trees!

Excellent, excellent! Now I just have to wait for them to grow!

You're keeping your word, and so am I! You can take as much water as you want - just do not wash your paws!
Ask Domina Cora about the mystery of your birth.

Ah, there you are. I’ve been waiting for your return for 3 days now, and was starting to doubt Cassandra’s words. Welcome to Sarnaut, child.

My name is Cora. I’m the Domina of Life. My duty is to welcome all Aoidoi into this world and bring them into our society.

Here, take these clothes - it wouldn’t do walking around Polis in your birthday suit. While you’re getting dressed, I can answer your questions.

I won’t keep you any longer. The process of being born is very exhausting - I remember it myself. Gravity has a particularly severe effect on our tough bodies, so our muscles need time to adjust to such pressure. Although you seem to be steady on your feet... It’s rare and I’m pleased to see it.
What can I help you with?
Teleport to Polis and speak to Cassandra, the Domina of Fates.

Cassandra predicted you would come, kid. She’s the Domina of Fates and has the gift of prophecy. Her counsel has saved us from many troubles and, dare I say, it will save us from many more.

She would like to see you as soon as we're finished talking. Go to her and you will see what heights our civilization has reached in nine years of existence.
Ah, finally. I've been waiting for you, Stormbringer.
Complete Ionas’s, Phoebus’s, and Dionysius’s quests, then return to Cassandra.

Yes, it’s true - I can look through the fabric of time and see what awaits us. Such vision requires great concentration, and I must be careful not to get lost in my own misconceptions.

I rarely see the birth of Aoidoi in my visions. But... I saw you. Something makes you special, child. I wish I knew what it was. Just one word is tied to your fate in my visions: Stormbringer.

But enough of ominous predictions! Your fate is uncertain. You should try and find your Talent, perhaps? Aoidoi will gladly help you with that. For example, Ionas, Phoebus, and Dionysius... Yes, they are all currently unoccupied. Don’t be surprised - all Dominae are connected through our minds, and I hear their thoughts like my own.

Go to them and try to find yourself. You’ll learn something about our life.
You shouldn’t despair if you haven’t found your calling. It may find you yet.
You shouldn’t despair if you haven’t found your calling. It may find you yet. You just need to wait a little longer. Phoebus’s idea isn’t that bad either - you are strong, so you could be a warrior.
Create a marble statue under the guidance of Ionas.

Oh, hello. Cassandra warned me that you were coming. So you wish to try your hand at stone cutting? Well, that’s commendable.

You won’t need a hammer, chisel, cutter, or other tools. What for, when you have your mind? Stone of Ammer is filled with life energy. You can talk to it, and it will assume any shape you wish... You just need to speak its language.

Take a piece of marble from that corner, will you?
Yeah... It looks like the stone can’t stand the sound of your voice. It’s the first time I’ve seen this happen. Well, I guess we both agree that making stone statues is out of the question for you.
Outrun the Kardis Unicorn in a race around the square, then spar with Phoebus.

Hello. My name is Phoebus, and I’m the patron of noble sports. I heard you’re trying to find your calling. Perhaps it’s sports?

It’s easy to find out, actually. There’s a Kardis Unicorn at the end of the square - I trained it. If you outrun the swift-footed beast, I will spar with you. And then we’ll find out if you’re any good in sports!
Honor and will are the marks of a good sportsman.

That... was... a good fight. Ugh!

Well, what you did was effective, and your uniform inspires respect. But such techniques are not allowed in sports, because they are dishonorable.... I have an idea! Perhaps you have a Warrior gift? Like Kyros? That would be nice. Try talking to him when you have time.
The Unicorn is ready to take off and waits for the command.
Drink ambrosia and play the harp for Dionysius.

So you want to learn to play music? Maybe you do have talent. There is a way to see it. Let me introduce myself. I’m Dionysius, the Dominus of Music. However, I do other things besides playing music, and... Hic! Oh, excuse me.

Making strings sing is easy, and I guess every second Aoidos can do it. But playing melodies that tear out hearts and heal souls is quite a different matter.

What I mean is - the true musician can create music even when drunk on ambrosia. I myself came up with a few of my enduring masterpieces while pleasantly inebriated! That’s what we’ll start the audition with. Take a sip of ambrosia, and then play the gold-stringed harp. And we will both see if you have Talent for music or the Muses dealt you short.
Music is the language of souls! Hic...
Alas, but music is not your forte. But don’t be upset - a musician’s life is full of pointless suffering, self-doubt, and emotional insecurity. And ambrosia. Lots of ambrosia... Hic!
Go to the neighboring island of the Refuge and find Kyros, the Dominus of War.

The ways of fate are inscrutable - I have just received a message from Domina Aellona. Something... strange happened near the Refuge. Refuge is our settlement on one of the neighboring islands. Kyros and Aellona already went there to find out what’s going on.

If you wish to speak with Kyros, you should do it now. Who knows, maybe by helping the Dominus of War, you’ll find your calling?

The area around the Refuge is crawling with dangerous creatures, so you’ll need proper equipment. I’ll give it to you. Once you’re ready to go, talk to Cantos, the Crossing Keeper. He’ll take you to the place.
Greetings, my friend. I’m sorry, but Kyros and Aellona left the Refuge. They don’t waste time going against the new threat.
Scout the area around the Refuge and find the strange creatures that attacked the Aoidoi.

I see you are equipped for a fight. I’m afraid I need your help.

Some time ago, our Refuge was attacked by strange creatures - Demons. They are the children of Chaos, creations of mad god Sarn. The walls built by Ionas held them off, because the Dominus of Stone is a great master of magic. But the Demons did not go anywhere! So we are trapped here - all of us.

Well, if you know how to use a weapon, you can look around the Refuge. There aren’t many warriors here - most left with Kyros, and we haven’t heard from them since. This uncertainty is bothering me! We should know if there are any demons around our house, and whether we should ask Polis for help.

So demons are actually here... That’s bad.

What was this strange knife-eared creature? You’re saying it stood on two legs, like us? Wore clothes and fought off monsters? And looked like a warrior?

This is unbelievable! What if it was an elf? There’s this people in Sarnaut... But what was he doing here?
Speak to Asclepia at the Refuge about your wound.

Creator almighty, you were wounded! Why didn’t you say so?!

Go to Asclepia, our healer. Who knows what infection was carried by that creature! Go now, hurry!
Thank you for what you did for the Refuge, child. Come on, let me take a look at your wound.
Gather petals of Blood Eye and Will-o’-the-Wisps near the Refuge.

Hm... Your wound is not serious, my friend, and not life-threatening as it is... However, there is something that bothers me. You were infected, and your body cannot overcome it on its own. I can slow the spread of infection, but I don’t know how to purge it. I’ll need to make a potion, but it’s not an easy one.

I am sorry, but you will have to father all ingredients yourself. I am completely helpless when it comes to demons. You will also need will-o’-the-wisps - manifested echos of divine power. Their life energy will help you only if you catch them with your own hands. There are a lot of them around the Refuge. You won’t miss them.

I’ll also need a flower called Blood Eye. Its healing properties will help you through the infection. It grows not far from here. Look around carefully - Blood Eye likes shadows.
Please, make no delay. What if this infection kills you?
Keep the potion - drink it when you can’t stand it much longer. Find a more experienced healer - perhaps someone knows how to cure this thing.
Find out what is going on near the entrance to the Refuge.

For the love of... what is this noise at the gates? Are demons attacking again?

Oh, it’s unbearable... Epius should ask Polis for help!

I have to say, you are absolutely insufferable! You know what it’s like when your brains are boiling? Well, I do now! And I could have lived my whole life without this knowledge.

And if I went crazy, then what? Even if I threw myself off a cliff, I’d still be reborn as an imbecile!
Find out what is going on near the entrance to the Refuge.

For the love of... what is this noise at the gates? Are demons attacking again?

Oh, it’s unbearable... Epius should ask Polis for help!
Sounds legit but couldn’t we do without this thrashing? Great Tensess, it’s like I drank some bad moonshine... See if I ever listen to some elves again! Magic-shmagic. Psha!
Help! Anybody?! Franz, you bastard. Get me out of here!
Ask Andrey Sechin  why the Empire arrived at Ammer and tell Epius about it.

To be honest, our recent intelligence was the reason we started searching for your town. To the south-east of here, we spotted a group of your people. Aoidoi? Well, that’s alright. Your presence was a surprise to us, so we wanted to deal with this prob... with this intriguing circumstance as soon as possible.

So the troop of Aoidoi was fighting demons. Victorious, they took up a defensive position near the portal... I have to say, the tactics of your people in combat raises a lot of questions. I imagine experienced fighters among you are fast disappearing?

I don’t know what happened to the Aoidoi later. Our scout decided to avoid direct contact. As for the reason for our first arrival at Ammer...

I’ll inform Polis about our guests, my friend, but right now I’m more worried about another news. They saw Aellona and Kyros with a troop of warriors! It means they’re still alive. But why aren’t they back already...?
Ask Gostomysl Ranov why League arrived at Ammer and tell Epius about it.

The reason we started to search for your treasure was because we spotted a group of your... people to the south-east of here. Aoidoi? Alright, let’s call them Aoidoi. We didn’t think anyone lived here, and you say you’ve been here all your life? Wow...

I got a bit carried away. So your brothers, Aoidoi, were fighting demons to the south-east of here. I should say you guys make lousy warriors, no offence. Out of the dozen, just two seemed like they knew what they were doing... Lucky for them though, demons were no better. Anyway, your people somehow took those demons down and should be hanging around the portal now.

Our scout decided not to disturb them. What if they take him out along with the demons? Gift of Tensess might save him, sure, but it’s best not to tempt fate. But if you’re interested how we ended up on Ammer...

I’ll inform Polis about our guests, my friend, but right now I’m more worried about another news. They saw Aellona and Kyros with a troop of warriors! It means they’re still alive. But why aren’t they back already...?
Articulation and gestures indicate that this creature is trying to have a rational conversation. But there is a problem - you cannot understand a single word.
It doesn’t work. The man spits on the ground angrily and extends his hand in greeting. Suspicious.
h: Try to explain that you can’t understand anything

t: Do you get what I’m saying? Well, thank Tensess!

Hello there... Whatever you are... The whole world will soon watch over these lands! Which isn’t surprising - it’s been a while since anything like that happened in the Astral! The sky was lit with colors I’ve never seen before, and lightnings were flashing here and there. Wow, that was something!

Then it all went quiet. So we rushed there to take a look at the place where two gods had died. It’s not like we really wanted to - but there’s also the Empire - who knew what they would find there?
h: Ask what League soldiers were doing on Ammer

t: Help Kyros and Aellona drive demons away from Polis boundary.

Kyros, Aellona, and their legate followers went to protect Polis boundary. Your help would be invaluable.

You see, Kyros is the only warrior among them, and he's not almighty... or immortal. Aellona loves him more than anything and will follow him even into the flames of war. I'm afraid that her blind devotion might end tragically.

My heart is uneasy. Please go to the east as soon as you can!
Well, hello hello, it’s been a while. What do you mean, “you don’t know me”? Ah yes, I forgot. Your Reincarnations have faulty memory. Ah, youth!

Amazing times are coming, New Child. There’s no pure faith in you yet, but your time has not come to an end. You’ll live.

I’ll show you the Light.

Sentinel. Servant. Gatekeeper. No more, no less. As long as there is Light, I’ll be here as well. And while I’m here, there’ll be Light.

Tell me, New Child, are you ready to accept my Gift?
Find Aellona the Domina, who has gone looking for the Demonic Portal.

Here, in the Refuge, Aellona used to be in charge. She is a merciful and brave Domina. When Demons were at our doorstep, she gathered everyone who could bear arms and led them to battle. They drove the Demons away and followed them, but they never came back. I am her apprentice, and I can feel her rage and sadness. Please find her. I’m afraid something bad might have happened.
I didn’t expect to see one of us here. We’re having a bad time, so I’ll take any help I can get. But what brings you here?

I am just a humble custodian of our residence. If you wish to learn more about our people, you should speak with the dominae.

However, I can tell you something.
Speak to Aellona and ask her what she plans on doing next.
Do you want to ask something? Go ahead then.
I can see you have many questions, but there isn't much time to talk.
It saddens me to think that those who bring only destruction were the first to arrive at Ammer. It’s the duty of all Dominae to protect our people.
Catch a bat and bring it to Aellona.

I can feel that you want to help me. I wouldn't dare to ask myself, but I would gladly accept any assistance.

These portals make so much noise, and I can't hear my beloved Kyros' heart. Is he safe? This is my only concern.

But who knows what is waiting on the other side of the portal? I have an idea... Could you please catch a bat? Take this magic decoy, it will help you.
Lure the bats with the decoy. They can be of help.
Now I will enchant it and send it on the other side of the portal. Hopefully, it will deliver my message and bring back the response.
Kill Demons in the Refuge vicinity and return to Aellona.

I wanted to ask you one more thing, though this request pains me. Chaos spawns are everywhere, and I fear for our people, who have found shelter within the walls of the Refuge. Our Sparks may return to the Flow after death, but death has different forms, and ours is such that when we die, we lose ourselves. I don't want this fate for the Aoidoi, which is why I am asking you to cut down those spawns of chaos without mercy. Let them quake in terror!
Thank you. I hope you will enjoy this reward.
Enter the Demonic Portal and find Kyros on the other say.

The bat is back! My plan has worked. I can feel Kyros' anger... There are so many enemies around him. He tells me to bring help, but who is going to help us?! We can't wait for the reinforcement from Polis! I must help him now! Will you come with me?
Who? What! How did you get here?!
What?! I asked Aellona to stay out of this... Oh, women!
Protect Kyros while he is destroying the Demonic claws.

I feel like you were born just a moment ago, but it matters little. Thank you for your military exploits and for helping Aellona. I’m just afraid that everything that happened until now was just a warm-up. Our allod is being torn apart by demon claws, and chaos spawns are climbing through the portals!

We must stop this demonic filth. There is no one else! Otherwise it will devour everything and become so powerful that even the walls of Polis, blessed with the breath of the creators, won't withstand it.

Will you help? I don't have the strength to destroy the enemy and chase away the filth at the same time. Your sword will be my only protection!
Go ahead! We don't have much time.

I'm glad to see how fiercely you fight our common enemies. There aren’t a lot of Aoidoi who can wield a sword and kill with it. The sons of Chaos have brought death to our lands, but you are giving us hope!
Destroy Desolator and return to the Refuge.

It is too soon to celebrate - I can sense the presence of the one who has brought that army to our lands. Anger and madness overwhelm him... I can't believe the Creator could let such ugly monsters invade his beautiful world. We must stop the hateful enemy!
I’m glad that I can call you a friend. There aren’t many Aoidoi who would do what you’ve done.
Teleport to Aidenus in Novograd and ask what happened.

The message is very short. Aidenus must have been afraid that it could be intercepted.

"Please come to my tower, friend. League needs your help. Aidenus"

You should go there right now. This seems serious.
Go see Aidenus in Novograd and ask what happened.

Another meeting! Listen, I got a letter from Aidenus... For you! So I wanted to give it you in person, just to be safe.

The old man is rather concerned, and with good reason...

The message is very short. Aidenus was probably worried it could be intercepted.

"I ask you to come to my tower without delay. The League needs your help again. Aidenus."

You should go see him right away. It sounds serious.
Finally! We can't waste even a minute.
Teleport to Yasker in Nezebgrad and ask what happened.

Another meeting! Listen, I got a letter from Yasker... For you! So I wanted to give it you in person, just to be safe.

Our great leader is rather concerned, and with good reason...

It looks more like a telegram than a letter. Yasker is being concise:

"The Empire calls upon its heroes. Report to Yasker's Tower immediately. Yasker."

It looks as though Yasker sent it to several heroes, but I really doubt that. It's meant for you!
I should probably remind you what "without delay" means. Sit down and listen. Time is pressing.
Teleport to the Yasker in Nezebgrad and ask what happened.

Yasker is being concise:

"The Empire calls for its heroes. Report to Yasker's Tower immediately. Yasker"

It looks as if he had sent it to several heroes, but I really doubt that.
Sit down and listen. We don't have much time.
Participate in the University's Opening Ceremony in Polis and talk to professors.

Greetings, Stormbringer! Zayan decided to move the University that he founded a century ago to Ammer. He wants the new civilization to find their way into Sarnaut's science, and Polis - to become one of the world's cultural capital. We're offering you to become the honorary student and inviting you to participate in the Opening Ceremony!

It's so good to see you at our ceremony! Considering the latest events, I don't think you have enough time to learn new things... But you may consider yourself an honorary student! Please, accept this merit badge.
Get to the Imperial Camp and ask the Commander to cure you.

The news that the Imperial forces took note of the fight but stayed out of it makes me angry. But maybe they’ll be of some use after all.

Don’t think I haven’t noticed your wound, my friend. Thank the gods that Asclepia managed to help you in time. My brother-in-arms, Ivar, died from a light injury not unlike yours. Cursed demonic infection consumed his body. The same will happen to you if you don’t find a cure.

The Empire has fought demons for centuries. If they truly wish to form an alliance with us, they should help you get well first. Let’s see what their words are worth. And they should also join the fight against demons. Then - and only then we will consider whether we should let them in.
Who are you again? Do you even speak our language? That’s a relief. Major Vasily Molodin, Imperial Sentinel. Nice to meet you.
Get to the League Camp and ask the Commander to cure you.

The news that the League forces took note of the fight but stayed out of it makes me angry. But maybe they’ll be of some use after all.

Don’t think I haven’t noticed your wound, my friend. Thank the gods that Asclepia managed to help you in time. My brother-in-arms, Ivar, died from a light injury not unlike yours. Cursed demonic infection consumed his body. The same will happen to you if you don’t find a cure.

The League has fought demons for centuries. If they truly wish to form an alliance with us, they should help you get well first. Let’s see what their words are worth. And they should also join the fight against demons. Then - and only then we will consider whether we should let them in.

Now who is our blue guest? Such a rare occasion. So you’re one of the locals? How many of you are there? Although, why am I asking such a thing? Never mind!

Bronislav Malinovsky, League Battlelord. Nice to meet you.
How can I help you, friend?
Meet Yasskul Jumany and ask him for cure.

Your leaders have an interesting way of doing things - sending dying messengers to potential allies. That’s nice. What am I to do with you...

Helping you deal with demons is not a problem. It doesn’t matter what they want - we won’t leave a single creature alive. I guess we don’t really have a choice, seeing how you guys fight, he he...

As for your wound - the answer is simple. Demonic taint can be cured by the Magic of Light. Trinity Church knows everything about it. Go to Yasskul Jumany. You won’t mistaken him for anything - a 2-meter tall corpse with bronze prosthetic limbs, and a white mask so as not to scare anyone with his bare skull. The Empire is full of these guys - so get used to it. The Arisen are brothers to us - just like Orcs, Xadaganians, and even some Pridens.

Well, what are you waiting for? You want to die in my arms?

I welcome you on behalf of the Trinity Church. I am Priest Yasskul Jumany.

Tremor, convulsions and irregular breathing are normal for your people?
Meet Avelinn de Blizare and ask for cure.

Your healers have a funny way of dealing with the sick - sending them to astral demons? So that they’re my responsibility now? And what am I supposed to do with you?

Helping you deal with demons is not a problem. It doesn’t matter what they want - we won’t leave a single creature alive. Though I heard you aren’t so good in a fight...

As for your wound - the answer is simple. Demonic taint can be cured by the Magic of Light. Trinity Church knows everything about it. Go to Avelinn de Blizare right away. You won’t mistaken her for anything - she is a stately one with wings. She has this look of innocence, but don’t let that fool you - we know what those elves are about, he he...

Well, what are you waiting for? Want to die here?

Hello! Avelinn de Blizare, nice to meet you. I make sure our soldiers don’t get themselves accidentally killed.

You look terrible. Is everything okay?

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"

Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!

Go in peace!
Go through the Communion Rite of the Trinity Church.

Yes, Vasily Molodin is absolutely right - demonic infection can only be cured by the Magic of Light, which is based on faith. Its power is so immense that a true believer can even resurrect without effort. It’s a phenomenon that is called the “Gift of Tensess”.

You see, the Communion Rite usually takes some time, but it’s clear that delay is tantamount to death here. So listen carefully - I’ll try to explain everything in simple words and without any occult references. Tensess is a real person, just like Nezeb and Skrakan. We worship those three as saints, for it was thanks to them that Gift of Tensess was granted to this world. We believe into the might of fallen Great Mages, and this faith helps us return to this world after a death of our mortal bodies. It is also what helped us defeat the demons, Architects and Nezeb knows what else. Useful? Yes. Unbelievable? Oh yes.

The only way you can survive is to accept this faith with your body and soul. If that’s what you want, I will begin the Rite. I’ve never done that in field conditions, to be honest.
I’ve never done that in field conditions, to be honest.

Safe and sound, I see? To be honest, I didn’t think you could become a believer so quickly. I’m sure it wasn’t my eloquence that did it, or was it?

Well, how are you feeling?
Go through the Communion Rite of the Church of Light.

A demonic infection? You poor thing... Yes, the Magic of Light allows us to purge the darkness from our bodies. Of course, it's not painless. And it's one thing to help those who already believe, and another is to make you believe it. Not to mention the fact that I'd have to carry out the Communion Rite in field conditions. Oh... Well, no time to complain.

Let's keep holy texts out of this discussion.  The Church of Light venerates Tensess as a saint who at death’s door gave us a great Gift: the ability to resurrect after a death of our mortal body. Tensess is a real person. Like us, he used to fight against the demonic threat... Back then, a long time ago. His sacrifice turned the tide of war. Immortality allowed us to withstand the attack of demonic creatures. And as you can see, we are still alive and thriving.

In our case, knowledge and faith are one. Accepting this knowledge is not enough: you need to believe with all your heart that the power of Light, the Gift of Tensess, can pull you from the other world. I'm deadly serious. No pun intended.

I’ve never seen anyone accept on true faith so quickly. Although, come to think of it, you haven’t been around long, so you accept knowledge with a childlike open-mindedness... How old did you say you were?

Hold on a second. You met the Servant? And he spoke to you directly?

This... I don’t know. It doesn’t seem like you’re making this up - you didn’t know about it... But try to understand me - it’s the first time I hear that the Servant has spoken to someone. That it... Anyway, your conversation doesn’t concern me. Great deeds await you, I guess?

At any rate, I’m glad that the Empire and Aoidoi are bound together with faith. I won’t delay you much longer - you are probably expected elsewhere. I wouldn’t want your friends to think you met your end at an imperial camp.

Go in peace!

Welcome back, Stormbringer. I see you are no longer suffering from sickness. Good.

And I feel... Something else.

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"

Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!

Go in peace!

Wait, wait. So you met the Servant? Really? Giant wings, blue flame, hair like a frenzied Harpy’s... ahem, excuse me.

Oh... It’s a great honor, to be honest. Oh, there we go again... The Servant is Light itself, the creature of immense power! And it spoke with you, just like that? Unbelievable! What did it say? Oh wait, it’s not really my business... Again. Actually, I’m really proud right now, like a Priden who lured a mammoth into a trap. Just think about it - I gave communion to the first of the Aoidoi who had also spoken with the Servant itself! Great deeds probably await you, no?

Well then, it’s time for you to head back, no? What if your friends thought that treacherous sons of the League stoned you to death in the middle of the camp?
Go now and carry Light with yo! I’m glad we are bound by our shared faith.

Welcome back, Stormbringer. I see you are no longer suffering from sickness. Good.

And I feel... Something else.
I sense a new power in you... It’s almost tangible. And so bright that it hurts to look at you. What happened to you among our guests? Tell me everything!
I sense a new power in you... It’s almost tangible. And so bright that it hurts to look at you. What happened to you among our guests? Tell me everything!
Demons got too close to our house. We can’t let that continue for much longer. Stormbringer, please help us again.
Take Wands of Oblivion away from the centaurs and return them to Apios.

I'm sorry... I must remain calm... Breathe in, breathe out... Right.

Our home, Triquetrum, was attacked by centaurs! I have no idea why. They just crashed in and started killing everyone! We were defenseless and never expected them to attack us. And now look...

Well, we had some means of self-defense, but we didn't have the time to use them. Wands of Oblivion can put anyone to deepest sleep with just one touch. We left those wands behind, in Triquetrum... The centaurs must have found them! Oh, Chaos!

We need to retrieve them as soon as possible.
Incredible... Just like that, in broad daylight...

Great! Now...

What? What do you need?!
Teach the Centaurs near the Aoidoi’s hideout a lesson.

You probably won’t like my request - I don’t like it myself. Centaurs’ scouts got too close to our hideout. If they spot us, they will kill us like those unfortunate souls in Triquetrum. I can't let that happen. We must strike first, because that’s the only language those savages understand.

Teach the Centaurs around here a lesson. You’ll make this place safer, and I’ll make sure you’re rewarded.
Good job, my friend. We can breathe more easily now.
Collect "Tears of Gods" and bring them to Daphne.

I beg you to forgive Apios, he's a bit... anxious. Aoidoi are not used to the sight of blood.

I need "Tears of Gods" to heal those who were severely wounded. It's difficult to confuse that mineral with anything... It's like liquid crystal, frozen in time.

Bring me several pieces. They have extremely powerful healing qualities.
Collect "Tears of Gods" and bring them to Daphne.

I beg you to forgive Apios, he's a bit... anxious. Aoidoi are not used to the sight of blood.

I need "Tears of Gods" to heal those who were severely wounded. It's difficult to confuse that mineral with anything... It's like liquid crystal, frozen in time.

Bring me several pieces. They have extremely powerful healing qualities.

Thank you so much!

Aoidos bodies are partly non-organic, and those non-organic parts are very similar to the "tears" in their compound. So we just mend our bodies using those minerals. This isn't really difficult.

Anyway, I guess you have things to do instead of just chatting with me.

A centaur settlement?! They will kill you in an instant! Like they did with Nimros...

Why, why would you need to go there? You say, they've kidnapped Maya? Of course, of course, I know where their settlement is. I can take you there if you want to. But I forbid you to kill any of them. That's right! Every life is sacred.

We can put the sentries out of our way with these wands and reach the village unnoticed. You distract them, and I will crawl up to them and stun them.

Go, now!
Remember that I will run away if there is any sign of danger.
Phew... This is it. We make a good team, right?
Collect Arrowhead leaves and bring them to Apios.

So, the hardest part is over, but the most interesting one is still ahead of us. We can approach the settlement through the ravine, but it is swarming with hungry beasts. Luckily, I know a way to deal with them.

There's that plain-looking bush that grows in this area, we call it Arrowhead. If you break its leaf and smell its sap, you will regret the day you were born.

Find those leaves. Meanwhile, I will check if there are no other centaur sentries around.
I just hope animals won't flee too fast, or they'll draw centaurs' attention.
Use the smell of Arrowhead to reach the centaur settlement and find Maya Milostina.

Okay, take this gruel and besmear yourself. Don't worry, you'll just wash your clothes afterwards.

We need to cross the ravine. I've walked this path two times before, so we won't get lost. I hope we make it on time and the centaurs haven't killed your preacher...
Praise the Light! I thought I was dead. Poor Whip... They trampled him to death!

I think I’m going to be sick... What is this smell, for gods' sake? Oh, it's you! I'm sorry...

Okay, let me pull myself together...

Oh great Light! If only I knew our faith could drive Aoidoi crazy!

But they are not everyone like that, are they? We must do something!
My friends are nowhere to be seen. They must have remembered they're mortal after all.

I don't understand how he's going to carry out his plan. The Servant of Tensess is in the Purgatory. In order to get into the Purgatory, you need to die... But Aoidoi cannot do that unless they believe in the Light! And even if they could, their Spark would be helpless against the Servant.

However, I know nothing either about Aoidoi, or that mysterious sorcerer, or about the centaur magic! We need to find someone who could help us. And fast!

Here you are, finally. Do you want to tell me something?

Because we have a centaur invasion here, and there isn't really much time to talk.

I'm particularly interested in the identity of the strange sorcerer and why he helps Kyros. Does he act on his own will, or does he have.... a Master?

Watch out. Who knows what he is capable of.
Destroy Demonic Portals in Polis vicinity.

The Aoidoi's commander-in-chief chose a bad time to weep in the corner. The space around the allod becomes more and more disturbed with every minute - demons are trying to break through the power of the Well, and soon they will succeed.

I marked several spots on the allod map where demonic portals will soon open. You know what needs to be done with them.

Here, take this simple device. It will reverse the processes inside the portal and restore the broken tissue of reality. Yes, I know something about technomagic!
What? Do you like demonic landscapes? If you hesitate a little longer, you might even see it from above.

Well, so you suggest we bargain with a demon, a merciless spawn of the Astral driven by murderous instincts... Sounds like a good idea. I knew I could rely on your rationality.

You started it, you will have to finish it. The most important thing is that the portals have been destroyed. Enjoy the views of Polis while you still can!

A red-headed sorceress who had arrived together with your allies was looking for you. She must have found out something important.

You should go and see her. She is a pro when it comes to fighting demons.
Finally. I've been looking for you.
Find out what the demon is trying to say and deliver his message to Cassandra the Domina.

This demon doesn't seem to be eager to kill the uninvited guest. It seems like it's even trying to deliver a message.

Maybe we should listen to what he has to say?

I must admit this was... unexpected.

It's a tough decision. But I know what should be done.
Obtain heart of local animals and bring them to Ollum.

Another message from Ollum seems to be a request, too.

You see short visions of how demons got rid of their destructive instincts. You see how the first creatures of this allod were born out of Sarn's boiling blood, which spilled on these virgin lands. Life energy overfills them, and their skin and fur shine brightly in the twilight of the eternal Astral storm.

Ollum's pack stopped hunting Aoidoi and started feeding on the hearts of those creatures. In fact, they turned into local predators. But after the hostile demons occupied Ammer, hunting has become much more difficult for them. Ollum wants you to help him obtain hearts.
Ollum gives you a questioning look.
You can feel demon's sincere gratitude when he gently accepts the hearts from your hands. Well, at least his pack will be fed for some time.
Obtain heart of local animals and bring them to Ollum.

Another message from Ollum seems to be a request, too.

You see short visions of how demons got rid of their destructive instincts. You see how the first creatures of this allod were born out of Sarn's boiling blood, which spilled on these virgin lands. Life energy overfills them, and their skin and fur shine brightly in the twilight of the eternal Astral storm.

Ollum's pack stopped hunting Aoidoi and started feeding on the hearts of those creatures. In fact, they turned into local predators. But after the hostile demons occupied Ammer, hunting has become much more difficult for them. Ollum wants you to help him obtain hearts.
Ollum gives you a questioning look.
You can feel demon's sincere gratitude when he gently accepts the hearts from your hands. Well, at least his pack will be fed for some time.
Destroy Shagarzak, Anolea, and Trihead and bring their hearts to Ollum.

Ollum sends you images of particularly dangerous creatures who, as he thinks, threaten lives of Aoidoi and small demons in his pack. Their hearts are especially valuable for Ollum.

He wants you to hunt those creatures, but at the same time, his message is somehow admonitory.
Ollum gives you a questioning look.
You can sense that the demon now respects you even more. Ollum accepts the hearts with reverent anticipation.
Ask demons of Ollum's pack to drink Cassandra's blood.

When I saw this conversation in a vision three days ago, I thought I was going insane. But here you are, repeating every word that you said in that vision.

I don't know whether those demons are saying the truth or trying to deceive us. However, I know a way to find that out...

I will give you my blood, Stormbringer. Tell demons to drink it. If they are not lying, they will agree, and then I will see their thoughts clearly. If they do that, come back to me.

Go now!
Did you bring my blood to the demons?

I must say I'm surprised.

I can sense no lies in that creature. It looks like in their aspiration to live they have warded off their very essence, instilled in them by the cruel god. Now they are just like us - alone and lost in this world... So here is what I say: if they wish to join our ranks, they are welcomed.

I feel their desire to live in peace with us. They can help us fight their less reasonable counterparts...

Do you know, Stormbringer, what this means for the world? The oldest enemy of the peoples of Sarnaut may soon become our friend! Oh those times will be blessed!
Bring the connecting crystal to Vasily Molodin.
You say, the Aoidos gave you this voluntarily? If it were not for your service record, I'd say that you're a great diplomat.
Give the connecting crystal to Svetlana Tropkina.

Don't you understand? Alright, enough with the diplomatic games. We don't have the time to wait for the registry to give us an answer. From what I know of your personal history, I can tell that Yasker trusts you with making decisions. Otherwise you wouldn't be here.

I strongly encourage you to help Aoidoi, especially since they gave you a key to their city. By the way, you should bring this crystal to Svetlana so that she could include Polis in the portal net.

Polis? I haven't heard of such thing.

Ah, you're from Vasily. Alright then, I'm not going to play dumb.

Give me your stone. I'll see what I can do.

...

Here you go. I have no idea where it will take you. So good luck!
Bring the Connecting Crystal to Bronislav Malinovsky.

Sadly, we have no time to search for answers. I have received news from the dominae that the enemy is approaching Polis. The mere thought of those ugly creatures tearing at our dearest city... ah!

We cannot let this happen!

You say, there's a whole nation who is ready to help us. Maybe I'm asking for too much, but this is our only chance on survival. Here, take this crystal. Use it to create a portal to Polis. Bring it to your expedition.

Hurry up!
They must be in a real trouble if they come asking us for help. There's one problem though...
Give the connecting crystal to Prosha Perova.

Now when we're done with the diplomatic stuff, I will tell you this: you need to give this crystal to the portal keeper girl and tell her I order to establish a connection with Polis as soon as possible. We can't wait.

How can we just leave them to the demons' mercy?!

For now, you will walk through this portal alone. Then we'll see.

You want me to add a new city to our net? This is so exciting!

Unless you were given an explosive alchemical artifact instead of a connecting crystal. I hope you can tell a real crystal from a fake one.

Because I can't.

...

That was easy. A new pathway to Polis is ready. Here you go!
Teleport to Polis and see what is going on there.

You see, we're just scouts and researchers, not diplomats. We cannot make an alliance with an unknown sentient race without an approval from the high command. Yasker and Elizaveta will be furious.

I will send a request to them. And you... you do whatever you want. Understood?
Ah, finally. As it was foretold, the Stormbringer will show up before the tempest.
